title: Track Day Lap Delta Regression
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=racechrono:lap track_name=* lap_time_seconds=*
| stats min(lap_time_seconds) as best_lap, max(lap_time_seconds) as worst_lap, avg(lap_time_seconds) as avg_lap by session_id track_name
| eval delta_to_best=round(avg_lap-best_lap,2)
| sort - delta_to_best
description: Ranks track sessions by how far the average lap drifted away from the best lap of the day.
value: A widening lap delta often points to fatigue, tire pressure drift, traffic, or inconsistent lines.
implementation: Ingest RaceChrono lap records with session and track identifiers, then compare the average lap with the session best.
visualization: Table of sessions with best lap, average lap, and drift from best.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which track sessions started fast but then faded or got messy.
